evidence: Sec. III.3 defines vertex trace by contraction of incoming/outgoing intertwiners.
Eqs. (41)-(44) introduce boundary normalization specifically for gluing consistency and state the spin-foam trace gluing identity.
Eq. (57) uses that trace in the spin-foam amplitude.
Eq. (4) defines the causal/Toller single-vertex amplitude by local replacement of Wigner D wedge functions.
Discussion states the paper focuses on a single vertex, described as a building block for a many-vertex path integral; no complete many-vertex causal contraction/gluing derivation is given.
